title: Put a five-piece wooden nesting doll set back together, each doll closed with its own top and its face lined up
instruction: Put the nesting dolls back together, each closed with its own top and its face lined up, the smaller ones inside the largest.
context: A nesting doll set is a familiar toy and ornament that comes apart in halves; putting it back together means matching each top to its own bottom by size, closing the inner doll before it goes into the next, and turning each top so its painted face sits over the apron. Each top is a 1.5 mm sliding fit over its own bottom's spigot, so it seats only when square and centred.
setup: Positions in mm from the midpoint between the two arm bases (x forward, y left, z up from the table top). One fixed layout, as in the screenshot. A five-piece turned linden nesting doll set, painted red with a cream face on each top and a cream apron on each bottom half (the face and apron are on the same side when a doll is closed). Doll 1: 150 mm tall and 71 mm across, split 60 mm up; its bottom half (38 g) stands open end up at x 220, y 40, apron toward the arms; its top (16 g) stands on its rim at x 300, y 220, its face turned a quarter turn from the apron. Doll 2: 110 mm by 52 mm, split 44 mm up; bottom (20 g) at x 220, y -180; top (8 g) at x 400, y -200, a quarter turn off. Doll 3: 72 mm by 34 mm, closed (it holds dolls 4 and 5; 21 g) at x 180, y -330. Walls 2.5 mm, floors 4 mm; each bottom half has a spigot 2 mm thick and 8 mm tall that its own top slides over with 1.5 mm to spare; an inner doll passes the next one's spigot with 2 mm to spare.
scoring: Read at the end from the video and a photo, and only while no gripper fingertip is within 20 mm of any piece. Inside: a doll or bottom half stands on the floor of the next bottom half, on its axis (within 3 mm) and upright (within 8 degrees). Closed: a top sits on its own bottom half, its rim on the shoulder (within 2 mm), centred (2.5 mm), square (5 degrees), its face within 15 degrees of the apron. 1.0: doll 3 inside doll 2, doll 2 closed and inside doll 1, doll 1 closed and upright (5 degrees), with no piece moving more than 1 mm and no fingertip near throughout the last 1 s. 0.75: doll 2, closed with doll 3 in it, stands inside doll 1 (or all of it but not yet still). 0.5: doll 2 is closed with doll 3 in it. 0.25: doll 3 is inside doll 2's bottom half. 0 otherwise; a top on the other doll's bottom does not count. 0 for good if any piece falls off the table.
reset_notes: Take the set apart: doll 3 closed with dolls 4 and 5 inside; stand each half of dolls 1 and 2 on its outline (bottoms open end up, tops on their rims) with the faces turned as marked.
fidelity: Rigid turned halves from a matryoshka outline at the stated sizes, lathed as 48-sided meshes with signed-distance colliders; masses from linden at 0.45 g/cm3. The real halves' snug friction fit is modelled as a 1.5 mm sliding fit that seats by weight; doll 3 and the two inside it are one solid body. Paint is visual only. Friction 0.5.
